issues.title: Single-Use Plastic Packaging
issues.hover_description: ESRS E5: 8Mt of plastics enter oceans annually. EU SUP Directive bans 10 categories. EPR fees up to 5% of packaging revenue.

issues.title: Consumer Recycling Infrastructure Gap
issues.hover_description: Only 14% of plastic packaging recycled globally. ESRS E5 circular economy obligation. Gap between producer responsibility and consumer behaviour.

issues.title: Palm Oil & Deforestation in Supply Chain
issues.hover_description: ESRS E4: 300 football fields of rainforest cleared daily for palm oil. EU Deforestation Regulation (2023) due diligence. 80% of consumer goods contain palm oil.

issues.title: Greenwashing & Green Claims
issues.hover_description: EU Green Claims Directive (2024): substantiation of eco-labels required. 53% of green claims were found vague or false (EU Commission). ESRS G1.

issues.title: Obesity & Ultra-Processed Food Impact
issues.hover_description: ESRS S2/S3: ultra-processed food linked to obesity pandemic (38% of adults globally overweight). WHO SHAKE initiative and front-of-pack labelling regulation.

issues.title: Living Wage in Agricultural Supply Chains
issues.hover_description: ESRS S2: 70% of global food workers earn below living wage. Tesco, Unilever Living Wage commitments. Supply chain traceability under EU CSDDD.

issues.title: Water Consumption in Food Production
issues.hover_description: Agriculture consumes 70% of global freshwater. ESRS E3: water risk in water-stressed regions. CDP Water Security risk assessment mandated.

issues.title: Food Waste Across Value Chain
issues.hover_description: 1/3 of all food produced is wasted (FAO). ESRS E5: circular economy target. EU Farm-to-Fork Strategy 50% waste reduction by 2030.

issues.title: Product Safety & Chemical Compliance
issues.hover_description: REACH, SVHC restrictions on hazardous substances in consumer products. ESRS G1. Recall costs average $10M per incident. PFAS ban in 2025.

issues.title: Scope 3 Upstream Emissions
issues.hover_description: 80-90% of FMCG GHG in value chain (Scope 3 Cat 1). ESRS E1: SBTi 1.5C alignment requires supply chain decarbonisation. CDP Supply Chain programme.
